The permanent effects of this ITEM can only stack up to 3 times. Retains turn after use.

Well-Liked.effect: Heals the target for 20 HP and gives them +1 DODGE, +5 Counterattack Damage, and +10 Counterattack Damage Dice Sides for the rest of the current battle. For the next 3 turns, the caster's advantages from this ITEM are doubled (except advantages gained from previous uses of this ITEM), also whenever the user rolls DODGE, or they are HIT by a Guaranteed FIGHT or Damaging MAGIC, they always Counterattack and heal based off the Damage dealt. The permanent effects of this ITEM can only stack up to 3 times. Retains turn after use.

Obsessed.effect: Heals the target for 30 HP and gives them +1 DODGE, +5 Counterattack Damage, and +10 Counterattack Damage Dice Sides for the rest of the current battle. For the next 3 turns, the caster's advantages from this ITEM are tripled (except advantages gained from previous uses of this ITEM), also whenever the user rolls DODGE, or they are HIT by a Guaranteed FIGHT or Damaging MAGIC, they always Counterattack and heal based off the Damage dealt. The permanent effects of this ITEM can only stack up to 3 times. Retains turn after use.

sibilance shake.title: Sibilance Shake
sibilance shake.effect: Heal the user's Party for 70 HP and gives them all each 1 Stasis Charge. Whenever a STATUS the target has afflicted or is afflicted with could be cured, they can use 1 Stasis Charge to afflict it for 1 more turn.
sibilance shake.description: The place this came from regards this as one of their more high-quality drinks. It's light on the stomach and extremely nutritious.

Well-Liked.effect: Heal the user's Party for 70 HP and gives them all each 1 Stasis Charge; the user heals 85 HP and gains 2 Stasis Charges instead. Whenever a STATUS the target has afflicted or is afflicted with could be cured, they can use 1 Stasis Charge to afflict it for 1 more turn.

Obsessed.effect: Heal the user's Party for 70 HP and gives them all each 1 Stasis Charge; the user heals 100 HP and gains 3 Stasis Charges instead. Whenever a STATUS the target has afflicted or is afflicted with could be cured, they can use 1 Stasis Charge to afflict it for 1 more turn; the user can instead use 2 Stasis Charges at once to double the effects of that STATUS for that turn. If the user is a member of the Sibilance, apply this effect regardless of their preference.

sinful soda.title: Sinful Soda
sinful soda.effect: Heals the target for 90 HP, then they roll 2d7, or 3d7 if used on Sapphire. If 1, afflict them with FURIOUS. If 2, afflict them with FIT. If 3, afflict them with LUCKY. If 4, afflict them with DEXTEROUS. If 5, afflict them with CONFIDENCE. If 6, afflict them with REFRESHED. If 7, afflict them with HEALTHY. These last for 2 turns.
sinful soda.description: “Hell yeah! My lovelies are getting the soda treatment~ Lust’s looks so good with that big larg-” - Sapphire

soda.title: Soda
soda.effect: Heals 90 HP and afflicts the target with JOYFUL.
soda.description: Take a drink of a cool carbonated soda! This is the original, but there are others in Orange, Cola, Melon, and… Lettuce flavor?

Well-Liked.effect: Heals 135 HP and afflicts the target with JOYFUL. This JOYFUL rolls 1d3, and fails on a 1 instead.

Obsessed.effect: Heals 180 HP and afflict the target with JOYFUL. This JOYFUL goes away after 2 extra turns.

starbit teabag.title: Starbit Teabag
starbit teabag.effect:
The user concentrates a turn before use. When finished, the target can decide to "Save" or "Use". Apply effects corresponding to what is chosen.
* Save: Place a "Starbit Tea" into the target's inventory.
* Use: Heal the target for 150 HP and afflict them with STARLIGHT (XV) for 2 turns. This STARLIGHT bypasses the tier limit and Overheals.
starbit teabag.description:
A few teabags with star symbols on them. (Not to be confused with Star Bits.)*
Unlock: ENDLP

Well-Liked.effect:
The user concentrates a turn before use. When finished, the target can decide to "Save" or "Use". Apply effects corresponding to what is chosen.
* Save: Place a "Starbit Tea" into the target's inventory.
* Use: Heal the target for 200 HP and afflict them with STARLIGHT (XX) for 2 turns. This STARLIGHT bypasses the Tier Limit and Overheals.

Obsessed.effect:
The user concentrates a turn before use. When finished, the target can decide to "Save" or "Use". Apply effects corresponding to what is chosen.
* Save: Place 2 "Starbit Tea"s into the target's inventory.
* Use: Heal the target for 200 HP and afflict them with STARLIGHT (XX) for 3 turns. This STARLIGHT bypasses the Tier Limit and Overheals.

starbit tea.title: Starbit Tea
starbit tea.effect: Heal the target for 200 HP and afflicts them with STARLIGHT (X) for 3 turns. Any healing over MAX HP from this ITEM is halved and treated as Overheal.
starbit tea.description: A glorious tea made from the finest Star Bits- Wait why did it say to not be confused with Star Bits on the last one, then?

Well-Liked.effect: Heal the target for 250 HP and afflicts them with STARLIGHT (XV) for 3 turns. This STARLIGHT bypasses the Tier Limit. Any healing over MAX HP from this ITEM is halved and treated as Overheal.

Obsessed.effect: Heal the target for 300 HP and afflicts them with STARLIGHT (XX) for 3 turns. This STARLIGHT bypasses the Tier Limit. Any healing over MAX HP from this ITEM is halved and treated as Overheal.

starlight float.title: Starlight Float
starlight float.effect:
The target heals 40 HP and rolls 1d4.
- Bitter (1): Heal 15 more HP and give them +4 DODGE for 2 turns.
- Sour (2): Heal 35 more HP and give them -4 HIT but +20 Damage for 2 turns.
- Salty (3): Heal them for 160 more HP, however any healing they receive for the next 3 turns is halved.
- Sweet (4): Afflict them with HYPER for 1 turn.
starlight float.description:
M*ade simply by putting Starlight Sundae on top of any type of Soda! Don’t sue us if you use Lettuce Soda for some reason unknown to even GOD-*
Price: 10 Candy

Well-Liked.effect:
The target heals 50 HP and rolls 1d4.
- Bitter (1): Heal 15 more HP and give them +5 DODGE for 2 turns.
- Sour (2): Heal 35 more HP and give them -3 HIT but +25 Damage for 2 turns.
- Salty (3): Heal them for 160 more HP, however any healing they receive for the next 2 turns is halved.
- Sweet (4): Afflict them with HYPER for 2 turns.

Obsessed.effect:
The target heals 60 HP and rolls 1d4.
- Bitter (1): Heal 15 more HP and give them +6 DODGE for 2 turns.
- Sour (2): Heal 35 more HP and give them -2 HIT but +30 Damage for 2 turns.
- Salty (3): Heal them for 160 more HP, however any healing they receive during their next turn.
- Sweet (4): Afflict them with HYPER for 3 turns.

tea.title: Tea
tea.effect: Heals 60 HP and gives the target +3 HIT for 1 turn. If the target’s next Action requires them to Concentrate, they can choose to skip a turn of Concentration; if they are already Concentrating, they can either cast it immediately or Concentrate for another turn (if available).
tea.description: "Coming straight from YOUR house, the 20th letter of the alphabet! He'll surely make you scream!”

Well-Liked.effect: Heals 75 HP and gives the target +4 HIT for 1 turn. If the target’s next Action requires them to Concentrate, they can choose to skip a turn of Concentration; if they are already Concentrating, they can either cast it immediately or Concentrate for another turn (if available).

Obsessed.effect: Heals 95 HP and gives the target +6 HIT for 1 turn. If the target’s next Action requires them to Concentrate, they can choose to skip a turn of Concentration; if they are already Concentrating, they can either cast it immediately or Concentrate for another turn (if available).

vexin vekimi.title: Vexin Vekimi
vexin vekimi.effect: Heal the target for 60 HP and afflict them with the "Guard" effect for 2 turns; while under the "Guard" effect, any effects that happen when the target DEFENDs are applied.
vexin vekimi.description: The place this came from regards this as one of their more high-quality drinks. Its flavors blend well and keeps the mind sharp.

Well-Liked.effect: Heal the target for 80 HP and afflict them with the "Guard" effect for 3 turns; while under the "Guard" effect, any effects that happen when the target DEFENDs are applied.

Obsessed.effect: Heal the target for 100 HP and afflict them with the "Guard" effect for 3 turns; while under the "Guard" effect, any effects that happen when the target DEFENDs are applied. The target also chooses to apply the effect of the Deep Concentration Badge, Quick Defense Badge, or Thorny Badge for this duration (these effects do not apply if the target already has these Badges or has the Shelter Badge). If the target is a member of the Vexins, apply this effect regardless of their preference.

white hot chocolate.title: White Hot Chocolate
white hot chocolate.effect: Heals the target equal to their White Chocolate Rating x4 and afflicts the target with FOCUSED for 2 turns. During the start of their next 2 turns, they heal the same amount.
white hot chocolate.description: Sweet White Chocolate from the Joyful Bakery, now in a drinkable form*!

accelerator.title: Accelerator
accelerator.effect: Double the amount of dice rolled for the target's next FIGHT, non-Ultimate Damaging MAGIC, or Battle ITEM, except for HIT.
accelerator.description: Be just like Suguri! OP as FU-

adrenaline shot.title: Adrenaline Shot
adrenaline shot.effect: Afflict the target with HYPER for 3 turns. Afterwards, afflict the target with the reversed effects of HYPER for 2 turns.

airhorn.title: Airhorn
airhorn.effect: Afflicts the party with FURIOUS for 1 turn. Retains turn after use.
airhorn.description: Okay, this shit is getting ANNOYING*!

alarm clock.title: Alarm Clock
alarm clock.effect:
Upon first use, this ITEM stays in the user's inventory and add 1 "Wind-Up" at the end of the user's turns if they have not used this ITEM. Upon second use, this ITEM is discarded and "Wind-Up" points are set to 0. Apply the corresponding effect for how many "Wind-Up" points there are. After first use, for every time the user is HIT, roll 1d5 and discard this ITEM and set "Wind-Up" points to 0 on a 1, but nullify all Damage from the HIT that discarded it.
0 Wind-Up: Target an opposing enemy and deal 3d15 damage. Recover the party from TIRED if they are afflicted with it, and ALERT for 1 turn if not.
1 Wind-Ups: Target an opposing enemy and deal 5d15 damage. Recover the party from TIRED if they are afflicted with it, and ALERT for 1 turn if not.
2 Wind-Ups: Target an opposing enemy and deal 7d15 damage and roll 1d20+5 HIT for modifiers. Recover the party from TIRED if they are afflicted with it, and ALERT for 2 turns if not.
3 Wind-Ups: Target an opposing enemy and deal 7d15 damage and roll 1d20+5 HIT for modifiers. Afflict a random party member with 1d3 tiers of RAGE for 3 turns. Recover the party from TIRED if they are afflicted with it, and ALERT for 2 turns if not.
4 Wind-Ups: Target an opposing enemy and deal 10d15 damage and roll 1d20+7 HIT for modifiers. Afflict a random party member with 1d3 tiers of RAGE for 3 turns. Recover the party from TIRED if they are afflicted with it, and ALERT for 2 turns if not.
5 Wind-Ups: Target an opposing enemy and deal 12d15 damage and roll 1d20+9 HIT for modifiers. Afflict a random party member with 1d3+1 tiers of RAGE for 3 turns. Recover the party from TIRED if they are afflicted with it, and ALERT for 2 turns if not.
6 Wind-Ups: Target an opposing enemy and deal 12d20 damage and roll 1d20+10 HIT for modifiers. Afflict the party with 1d3+1 tiers of RAGE for 3 turns. Recover the party from TIRED if they are afflicted with it, and ALERT for 3 turns if not.
7 Wind-Ups: Target an opposing enemy and deal 15d20 damage and roll 1d20+10 HIT for modifiers. Afflict the party with 1d3+2 tiers of RAGE for 3 turns. Recover the party from TIRED if they are afflicted with it, and ALERT for 4 turns if not.
8+ Wind-Ups: Add 2 dice to damage per turn Wound-Up past 7.
alarm clock.description: ...please don't wind it up too much, we may become deaf.

big pencil rocket.title: Big Pencil Rocket
big pencil rocket.effect: Roll HIT and Damage against the target; Damage is 1d50. Double any advantages to HIT and Damage to the user’s FIGHT, as well as any increases to HIT and Damage Dice Sides, and add them to these rolls.
big pencil rocket.description: It's a pencil... rocket? Looks just like a pencil to me... dunno how this thing would ever blow u-

bottle of bees.title: Bottle of Bees
bottle of bees.effect: Deal 50 Damage to the target afflict them with ALLERGIC for 3 turns.
bottle of bees.description: Just take the description of Lettuce Soda and put it here.

flamethrower.title: Flamethrower
flamethrower.effect: Roll 1d20+7 HIT and 1d75+40 Damage against the target. Afflict the target with either (HARD) BURN, (FULL) BURN (V), or INFERNO (V) for 3 turns.

glass cannon.title: Glass Cannon
glass cannon.effect: The target chooses Strong, Critical, or Devastating. The target's next FIGHT or non-Ultimate MAGIC is guaranteed and has no HIT roll, but the modifier is the one chosen. Until the caster's next turn, any attacks against them also have that modifier if they HIT. Retains turn after use.
glass cannon.description: A cannon that breaks in one use! Seriously, how do you expect this to survive that much gunpowder?

handy glove.title: Handy Glove
handy glove.effect: The user casts Metronome. If Metronome MISSes, this ITEM isn't used up. Retains turn after use.
handy glove.description: A nice little glove that makes a strange thing happen... Good luck!

kill code.title: Kill Code
kill code.effect: Afflict everyone in the Battle with GAME-BREAK for 2 turns.
kill code.description: Wait did you just delete SYSTEM 32-

loaded dice.title: Loaded Dice
loaded dice.effect: The target chooses the result of their a future coinflip or die roll; this cannot be used on a roll with sides of 21 or higher. Retains turn after use.
loaded dice.description: Ah, normal dice for a normal Roleplay sessio- Wait a minute…

magic door.title: Magic Door
magic door.effect: The user rolls 1d20 until they roll a 2 or 1. For each roll, deal 1d15+5 Damage to the target; if a roll was 17-20, instead deal 1d15+10 Damage for that roll.
magic door.description: I'm over here! No! Now I'm over here!

maple syrup.title: Maple Syrup
maple syrup.effect: Can be used on a party member or an enemy. If used on a party member, heal them for 60 HP and afflict them with SAPPED for 3 turns, but its effects are reversed. If used on an enemy, deal 1d30 Damage and afflict them with SAPPED for 3 turns, bypassing immunities. Both afflictions of SAPPED make the afflicted lose -4 to HIT and take 1d30+15 Damage at the start of their turns.
maple syrup.description: What are you? Canadian? Who drinks this out of the bottl- Oh… sapping enemies, right.

Well-Liked.effect: Can be used on a party member or an enemy. If used on a party member, heal them for 80 HP and afflict them with SAPPED for 1d2+2 turns, but its effects are reversed. If used on an enemy, deal 1d50 Damage and afflict them with SAPPED for 3 turns, bypassing immunities. Both afflictions of SAPPED make the afflicted lose -4 to HIT and take 1d45+20 Damage at the start of their turns.

Obsessed.effect: Can be used on a party member or an enemy. If used on a party member, heal them for 100 HP and afflict them with SAPPED for 4 turns, but its effects are reversed. If used on an enemy, deal 1d70 Damage and afflict them with SAPPED for 3 turns, bypassing immunities. Both afflictions of SAPPED make the afflicted lose -4 to HIT and take 160+25 Damage at the start of their turns.

microphone.title: Microphone
microphone.effect: The next FIGHT, Damaging MAGIC, or Battle ITEM the caster uses becomes AoE, but if more than 1 target is HIT, all Damage from this becomes halved. If it is already AoE, it is unaffected.

moonlight candle.title: Moonlight Candle
moonlight candle.effect: When this ITEM is used, halve the tiers of any currently afflicted bad STATUSes on the party, heal the caster and their party for 1d75 HP, and set "Durability" to 5. Coinflip at the end of the user's turns. On a tails, reflip until a heads is achieved. For every tails, lower "Durability" by 1. While "Durability" is higher than 0, the caster and their party heal 25 HP each turn, have +4 in Critical Chance, and have +4 in Counterattack Chance. Another Moonlight Candle cannot be used until all uses of this one are used up.
moonlight candle.description:
"This candle glows a brilliant blue, and illuminates the darkest corners."*
Price: 10 Candy

motivational poster.title: Motivational Poster
motivational poster.effect: If the user's party has any Bad STATUSes afflicted onto themselves, remove a turn to their duration. Turn retained after use.
motivational poster.description: We need YOU to fight the evil furries on TV!

multi-bottle rocket.title: Multi-Bottle Rocket
multi-bottle rocket.effect: Roll HIT and Damage 10 times; Damage is 1d30, also the caster cannot be countered when using this ITEM. Add 1/Xth of the caster’s Damage advantage for each successful HIT, X being the number of successful HITs, and also add the caster’s HIT advantage to the HIT rolls.
multi-bottle rocket.description: ...Okay. I guess Rockets are now considered consumables... yay?

nanner peel.title: Nanner Peel
nanner peel.effect:
Target a party member. The next time they are attacked, apply effects until the end of the target’s next turn. Turn retained after use.
- 5 unreducable damage.
- HITs against them are guaranteed.
- Damage dealt to them is multiplied by 1.5x.

neutralizer.title: Neutralizer
neutralizer.effect: The Neutral STATUSes of the caster's party last 1 more turn, also any negative effects of them are nullified. If the negative effects rely on a dice roll/coin flip, remove them from the roll/flip.

ocarina.title: Ocarina
ocarina.effect: Flip 10 coins. For the first 5 heads, deal 15 Damage to the target and afflict them with TRANCED (I) for 3 turns. For any heads past that, increase the duration of TRANCED by 1 turn. If there is an effect that allows the user to choose 1 coinflip, they can choose up to 3 from this ITEM.
ocarina.description: Some say playing this instrument the right way will send you through time…

pencil rocket.title: Pencil Rocket
pencil rocket.effect: Roll HIT and Damage against the target. Add the user’s Damage advantage, triple the user’s HIT advantage, and any increase to HIT and Damage Dice Sides, to these rolls. If HIT is 30+ (or 27+ if the user is equipped with the Weak Point Badge), damage is considered Celestial (4x). If HIT is 35+ (or 32+ if the user is equipped with the Weak Point Badge), damage is considered Decimating (5x).
pencil rocket.description: Your average Big Pencil Rocket, now in small form! Now I'm sure this one wouldn't blow u-

pencil sharpener.title: Pencil Sharpener
pencil sharpener.effect: The target loses 20 MAX HP but gains +20 Damage for the rest of the battle. If already used on a target, it cannot be used again.
pencil sharpener.description: For the cost of a bit of health, you become sharp and pointy!

pipe bomb.title: Pipe Bomb
pipe bomb.effect: Target party member with this ITEM. The next time they are HIT by an enemy, roll 1d25 HIT and 5d45 Damage. This ITEM can be concentrated for 1 turn; if it is, it ignores enemy DODGE and has +5 HIT.
pipe bomb.description: ...who the fuck put a pipe bomb in my mail bo-

poisoned spikes.title: Poisoned Spikes
poisoned spikes.effect: Use on an enemy. Roll 1dX, X being equal to the user’s combined Chocolate Ratings. The target takes that much Damage and loses that much Damage advantage for 2 turns.
poisoned spikes.description: These ones are NOT chocolate, don't even think about ingesting them!

portable shield.title: Portable Shield
portable shield.effect: Gives the target a 50 HP shield that makes the target IMMUNE to Bad STATUSes while up.
portable shield.description: It just looks like a tiny badge, but don't be fooled. These holograms can block ANYTHING!

power crystal.title: Power Crystal
power crystal.effect: Reduces the Cooldown of one of the target’s non-Ultimate MAGICs to 0.
power crystal.description: Rejuvenates the SOUL and allows the use of powers prematurely! Lay waste to your enemies!

Well-Liked.effect: Reduces the Cooldown of one of the target’s non-Ultimate MAGICs to 0 and heals the target for 40 HP.

Obsessed.effect: Reduces the Cooldown of up to 2 of the target’s non-Ultimate MAGICs to 0 and heals the target for 40 HP.

quick scope.title: Quick Scope
quick scope.effect: Retains turn after use. The target gains +5 to HIT for 1 turn; any HIT rolls of 30+ (or 27+, if the target is equipped with the Weak Point Badge) for that duration are treated as Celestial (4x).
quick scope.description: Does not work better if you turn 360 degrees before applying it. Trust me, I tried.

silver bullet.title: Silver Bullet
silver bullet.effect: The next non-ultimate attack the target uses has +0.5 in multiplier. Turn retained after use.
silver bullet.description: These can pierce a werewolf, as for anyone else, it’d hit them hard too.

single-use pistol.title: Single-Use Pistol
single-use pistol.effect: Deal 30 Damage to the target, then roll 1d6+4. If this roll is a 6 or more, deal the Damage and roll the 1d6 again, but decrease the modifier by 1. This Damage cannot be lowered.
single-use pistol.description: Technically a 100% off coupon if you are brave enough!

sticker pack.title: Sticker Pack
sticker pack.effect: If the user's party has any Good STATUSes afflicted onto themselves, add 1 turn to their duration. Turn retained after use. If a STATUS has already been affected by this ITEM before, then it does not affect said STATUS.

strong rope.title: Strong Rope
strong rope.effect: Skip the target's next turn. Any attacks against them are Guaranteed until their skipped turn has passed; if the target’s turn cannot be skipped, instead make it so all attacks against them are Guaranteed for 3 turns, and any other enemies have all attacks against them Guaranteed until the start of the user’s next turn.
strong rope.description: Perfect to tie any enemy up! Make sure to make a tight knot so that there will be a difficult escape.

syringe.title: Syringe
syringe.effect: Deal 1d20 damage to the target and afflict them with a Bad STATUS of the user's choice for 2 turns. This bypasses immunities.
syringe.description: ...this syringe looks sketchy. Don't inject yourself with it.

throwing dagger.title: Throwing Dagger
throwing dagger.effect: The target takes 1d20+5 Damage and is afflicted with BLEED (III), then the user rolls 1d100; if it is a 40 or more, the ITEM stays in the target's inventory. This threshold becomes 10 more for every time it is used. Retains turn after use.
throwing dagger.description: A certain Fox-masked rouge makes this look WAY easier than it really is...

tuning wrench.title: Tuning Wrench
tuning wrench.effect: The user also chooses 1 Battle ITEM to use along with this ITEM. Any Damage and effects that ITEM applies are multiplied by 1.5x also their HIT, if any, is Guaranteed, if not already. Turn cannot be retained if this ITEM is used, and it cannot be used on a retained or extra turn.
tuning wrench.description: Hey, maybe this will make Battle ITEMs viable!

soul serum.title: SOUL Serum
soul serum.effect: Afflict the target with one of their SOUL STATUSes for 3 turns. This SOUL STATUS cannot be made permanent.
soul serum.description: An odd concoction labeled as "experimental"... Oh well! What's the worst that can happen?

aloe vera.title: Aloe Vera
aloe vera.effect: The user also chooses 1 Revive ITEM to use along with this ITEM. The target overheals 1.5x the amount they would've had from the ITEM and is afflicted with REFRESHED for 3 turns. Turn cannot be retained if this ITEM is used, and it cannot be used on a retained or extra turn.
aloe vera.description:
Creates a soothing feeling and protects your wounds…
Price: 10 Candy

chocolate mint.title: Chocolate Mint
chocolate mint.effect:
Revive the target with 5*X% of their HP. This can overheal. X is equal to the target's Chocolate Ratings (Max. 30). Apply effects corresponding to the target’s Chocolate Ratings.
* 31 - 35: The target is afflicted with COZY for 1d2+1 turns.
* 36 - 44: The target is afflicted with FOCUSED, STRONG, and DEXTEROUS for 1d2 turns.
* 45+: The target is afflicted with HYPER for 2 turns; this HYPER overheals half past MAX HP.
chocolate mint.description: ...Please, PLEASE don't show this to Chara.

crepe.title: Crepe
crepe.effect:
If the target isn’t KO’d, heal the target for 25 HP and afflict them with COZY for 2 turns. If the target is KO’d, set their HP to 0 and roll 2d4 and apply the corresponding effects:
1 - Whipped Cream: +10% MAX HP heal. Afflict COZY to the target for 2 turns.
2 - Chocolate Syrup: Heal the target for 1% of their MAX HP multiplied by their combined Chocolate Ratings, and afflict them with EMPOWERED for the duration of their combined Chocolate Ratings divided by 15.
3 - Strawberries: +20% MAX HP heal. Afflict the target with NIMBLE for 2 turns.
4 - Powdered Sugar: +5% MAX HP heal. Afflict the target with HYPER for 1 turn.
If there are repeats, add 1 turn to the duration of the corresponding STATUS.
crepe.description: The burrito of the dessert world.

Well-Liked.effect:
If the target isn’t KO’d, heal the target for 40 HP and afflict them with COZY and EMPOWERED for 2 turns. If the target is KO’d, set their HP to 0 and roll 3d5 then apply the corresponding effects:
1 - Whipped Cream: +15% MAX HP heal. Afflict COZY to the target for 3 turns.
2 - Chocolate Syrup: Heal the target for 1.5% of their MAX HP multiplied by their combined Chocolate Ratings, and afflict them with EMPOWERED for the duration of their combined Chocolate Ratings divided by 10.
3 - Strawberries: +25% MAX HP heal. Afflict the target with NIMBLE for 3 turns.
4 - Powdered Sugar: +10% MAX HP heal. Afflict the target with HYPER for 2 turns.
5 - Blueberries: +20% MAX HP heal. Afflict the target with FOCUSED for 2 turns.
If there are repeats, add 1 turn to the duration of the corresponding STATUS.

Obsessed.effect:
If the target isn’t KO’d, heal the target for 55 HP and afflict them with COZY, EMPOWERED, and NIMBLE for 2 turns. If the target is KO’d, set their HP to 0 and roll 4d6 then apply the corresponding effects:
1 - Whipped Cream: +15% MAX HP heal. Afflict COZY to the target for 3 turns.
2 - Chocolate Syrup: Heal the target for 1.5% of their MAX HP multiplied by their combined Chocolate Ratings, and afflict them with EMPOWERED for the duration of their combined Chocolate Ratings divided by 10.
3 - Strawberries: +25% MAX HP heal. Afflict the target with NIMBLE for 3 turns.
4 - Powdered Sugar: +10% MAX HP heal. Afflict the target with HYPER for 2 turns.
5 - Blueberries: +20% MAX HP heal. Afflict the target with FOCUSED for 3 turns.
6 - Honey: +15% MAX HP heal. Afflict the target with RELAXED (III) for 3 turns. If two or more rolls were Honey, make this STATUS permanent and add an extra tier of RELAXED for every Honey roll past two.
If there are repeats, except for Honey, add 1 turn to the duration of the corresponding STATUS.

lotus.title: Lotus
lotus.effect: Stores the user's current HP, MAX HP, Shield, STATUSes, STATUS duration, effects, effect duration, and non-ultimate MAGIC cooldowns. When the user is KO'd in the same battle, revive them with the HP and MAX HP they were at when they used this, and replace their current conditions with the stored conditions. Only one of this type of ITEM can be used in the same battle.
lotus.description: Who knew picking flowers could grant you a second life?

marshmallow.title: Marshmallow
marshmallow.effect: Revives the target with 35% HP and cures them of all Bad and Neutral STATUSes. The target also takes half Damage for 1d2+1 turns; on the first turn, they take no Damage.
marshmallow.description: Feels like it is infused with the power of a god…

revisional cake.title: Revisional Cake
revisional cake.effect: Heals the party for 50 HP and revives any KO'd Party Members with 50% HP.
revisional cake.description: A life-giving cake! No... it's literally, it gives life! Not a scam at all!

revive-dust.title: Revive-Dust
revive-dust.effect: Revives a KO'd Party Member with half HP. Retains turn after use.
revive-dust.description: Sprinkle this magic powder onto an unresponsive party member and watch them get back up, full of energy! There is probably cocaine in this but we don't need to talk about that.

revive-mint.title: Revive-Mint
revive-mint.effect: Revives a KO’d Party Member with full HP.
revive-mint.description: The same cocai- I mean. Dust you always loved but in mint form! Have at it!

soda tablets.title: Soda Tablets
soda tablets.effect:
Retains turn after use.
- If the target is KO'd: Revive them to 90 HP. If Clementine has this in her inventory, she can use this on herself, but it doesn't retain turn, however she gets a random STATUS from a random Soda ITEM.
- If the target isn't KO'd: Doesn't do anything on first use. At the start of the target's next turn, heal them for 90 HP and afflict them with a chosen STATUS from any Soda ITEM for 3 turns. If used on Clementine, heal her for 180 HP and apply the non-healing effects of a Chosen Soda ITEM instead, as if it were Obsessed.
soda tablets.description: "Just add to water and wait... Humans are 67% water, right?" - Clementine

toasted marshmallows.title: Toasted Marshmallows
toasted marshmallows.effect: Revives a KO'd Party Member with half HP and afflicts them with (SOFT) BURN for 3 turns without a disadvantage. While (SOFT) BURN is afflicted, the target also deals 1.5x damage.
toasted marshmallows.description: You can feel the wrath of a god staring you down for burning this...

tumbiecake.title: Tumbiecake
tumbiecake.effect: If the target is KO’d, heal them to 2/5 of their HP and give them a shield equal to half of their MAX HP. This shield takes half damage from AoE attacks. If the target is not KO’d, they take 50 damage, but take half damage for 2 turns and for the same duration, they coinflip when rolling for HIT or DODGE, on heads, they have +6 to the corresponding roll.
tumbiecake.description: Hurts a bit on the way down, but it’s very nice! Maybe it’d feel better if you were numb to it somehow…

apple.title: Apple
apple.effect: Heals 40 HP and afflicts the target with HEALTHY for 3 turns.
apple.description: Don’t wanna see a doctor, do you? An apple a day keeps the doctor away, but also makes you feel better about yourself.

Well-Liked.effect: Heals 40 HP. Afflicts the target with HEALTHY for 3 turns and JOYFUL.

Obsessed.effect: Heals 40 HP. Afflicts the target with MOSSY and HEALTHY for 3 turns and JOYFUL.

assorted chocolates.title: Assorted Chocolates
assorted chocolates.effect: Heals the target for 6dX HP. The X is equal to the target's combined Chocolate Ratings. Retains turn after use.
assorted chocolates.description: Ah, chocolate of every kind, perfect for Valentine's Day.

assorted gummies.title: Assorted Gummies
assorted gummies.effect: Heals the target for 50 HP, and the user retains their turn afterwards.
assorted gummies.description: Have a quick snack break in the middle of battle! Though… not nutritional.

Well-Liked.effect: Heals the target for 80 HP, and the user retains their turn afterwards.

Obsessed.effect: Heals the target for 120 HP, and the user retains their turn afterwards.

astelava cake.title: Astelava Cake
astelava cake.effect: Heal the target for 50 HP and afflict them with MOONLIGHT (VII) for 1 turn. If being used on the last use, then heal the target for 150 HP and afflict them with MOONLIGHT (XXI) for 3 turns; this MOONLIGHT bypasses tier restrictions and the heal roll is the same as the effect roll.
astelava cake.description: Has actual non-harmful lava in it from the small lava mountains on Asterumbies!

Well-Liked.effect: Heal the target for 60 HP and afflict them with MOONLIGHT (VIII) for 1 turn. If being used on the last use, then heal the target for 180 HP and afflict them with MOONLIGHT (XXIV) for 3 turns; this MOONLIGHT bypasses tier restrictions and the heal roll is the same as the effect roll.

Obsessed.effect: Heal the target for 70 HP and afflict them with MOONLIGHT (X) for 1 turn. If being used on the last use, then heal the target for 210 HP and afflict them with MOONLIGHT (XXX) for 3 turns; this MOONLIGHT bypasses tier restrictions and the heal roll is the same as the effect roll.

baked alaska.title: Baked Alaska
baked alaska.effect: Heals the party for 75 HP, then each healed member rolls 1d6. If 1 or 2, afflict them with FROZEN for 1 turn. If 3, give them +3 to DODGE for 2 turns. If 4, give them +3 to HIT for 2 turns. If 5, give them +10 to Damage for 2 turns. If 6, give them the effects of 3, 4, and 5 for 3 turns.
baked alaska.description: "...w-why is Alaska being baked? ...how do you even get an oven that big?" -Mizu

Well-Liked.effect: Heals the party for 75 HP, then each healed member rolls 1d6. Heals the user for 90 HP instead. If 1 or 2, afflict them with FROZEN for 1 turn. If 3, give them +3 to DODGE for 2 turns. If 4, give them +3 to HIT for 2 turns. If 5, give them +10 to Damage for 2 turns. If 6, give them the effects of 3, 4, and 5 for 3 turns. For the user, 2 lowers all their Cooldowns by 1.

Obsessed.effect: Heals the party for 75 HP, then each healed member rolls 1d6. Heals the user for 120 HP instead. If 1 or 2, afflict them with FROZEN for 1 turn. If 3, give them +3 to DODGE for 2 turns. If 4, give them +3 to HIT for 2 turns. If 5, give them +10 to Damage for 2 turns. If 6, give them the effects of 3, 4, and 5 for 3 turns. For the user, 1 instead rerolls the d6 and 2 lowers all their Cooldowns by 1. For them, 6 also applies the 2 effect.

banana.title: Banana
banana.effect: Heal the target for 10 HP. Retains turn after use. If all 7 uses are used in the same battle, afflict the target with HYPER for 3 turns.

Well-Liked.effect: Heal the target for 16 HP. Retains turn after use. If all 7 uses are used in the same battle, afflict the target with HYPER for 3 turns and DEXTEROUS, STRONG, or FOCUSED for 3 turns.

Obsessed.effect: Heal the target for 22. Retains turn after use. If all 7 uses are used in the same battle, afflict the target with HYPER for 3 turns and DEXTEROUS, STRONG, or FOCUSED for 7 turns.

banana-milk chocolate cake.title: Banana-Milk Chocolate Cake
banana-milk chocolate cake.effect: Heals the party equal to their Milk Chocolate Rating x10.
banana-milk chocolate cake.description: Fresh Bananas baked with flavorful Milk Chocolate into a cake made to share. Recipe made by the partner of the maid who made the Sylna Cookies.

banana pudding.title: Banana Pudding
banana pudding.effect: Heal the target for 50 HP and afflict them with COZY and 1d4+1 Tiers of RELAXED for 2 turns; these can combine into COMFORTABLE. Both uses can be used at once on the same target, and if done so, COMFORTABLE is afflicted for 3 turns instead and the target gains +5 to HIT, +5 to DODGE, or +15 to Damage for 1 turn.
banana pudding.description: Mmm… So flavorful, and comes with nice Nilla wafers.

Well-Liked.effect: Heal the target for 60 HP and afflict them with COZY and 1d3+2 Tiers of RELAXED for 3 turns; these combine into COMFORTABLE. Both uses can be used at once on the same target, and if done so, COMFORTABLE is afflicted for 4 turns instead and the target gains +6 to HIT, +6 to DODGE, or +25 to Damage for 1 turn.

Obsessed.effect: Heal the target for 80 HP and afflict them with COZY and 1d2+3 Tiers of RELAXED for 4 turns. Both uses can be used at once on the same target, and if done so, COMFORTABLE is afflicted for 5 turns instead and the target gains +6 to HIT, +6 to DODGE, or +25 to Damage for 2 turns.

banana taffy.title: Banana Taffy
banana taffy.effect: Does nothing when first used. 2 turns afterwards, heal the target for 150 HP and afflict them with HYPER for 1 turn.
banana taffy.description: This stuff is so hard to chew- EHEHEHEHEHEHEHEHE~!

Well-Liked.effect: Does nothing when first used. 3 turns afterwards, heal the target for 200 HP and afflict them with HYPER for 2 turns.

Obsessed.effect: Does nothing when first used. 4 turns afterwards, heal the target for 300 HP and afflict them with HYPER for 3 turns.

banana tiramisu.title: Banana Tiramisu
banana tiramisu.effect:
Heal the target for 75 HP. The user’s next normal MAGIC has its cooldown treated as if it were an ultimate and has +2 CD, but the following effects are applied. If there’s a MAGIC still on cooldown that was affected by this ITEM, then only heal.
* If Damaging: Double damage dice and deal 1.5x damage. If there are no damage rolls, then deal 3x damage instead.
* If non-Damaging: Healing is doubled and anything healed past MAX HP is halved and treated as overheal. If healing is less than 75 HP, then double any STATUSes and effects unless it’s a multiplier to damage.

Well-Liked.effect:
Heal the target for 90 HP. The user’s next normal MAGIC has its cooldown treated as if it were an Ultimate and has +1d2+1 CD, but the following effects are applied. If there’s a MAGIC still on cooldown that was affected by this ITEM, then only heal.
* If Damaging: Double damage dice and deal 1.75x damage. If there are no damage rolls, then deal 4x damage instead.
* If non-Damaging: Healing is doubled and anything healed past MAX HP is cut by 2/3rds and treated as overheal. If healing is less than 90 HP, then double any STATUSes and effects unless it’s a multiplier to damage.

Obsessed.effect:
Heal the target for 105 HP. The user’s next normal MAGIC has its cooldown treated as if it were an Ultimate and has +3 CD, but the following effects are applied. If there’s a MAGIC still on cooldown that was affected by this ITEM, then only heal.
* If Damaging: Double damage dice and deal 2x damage. If there are no damage rolls, then deal 5x damage instead.
* If non-Damaging: Healing is doubled and anything healed past MAX HP is treated as overheal. If healing is less than 105 HP, then double any STATUSes and effects unless it’s a multiplier to damage.

beef jerky.title: Beef Jerky
beef jerky.effect: Heal the target for 50 HP and afflicts them with CONFIDENCE for 2 turns.
beef jerky.description: "Jerky? What did it ever do to you?! Don't call it names.”

Well-Liked.effect: Heal 60 HP to the target and afflict them with CONFIDENCE for 3 turns.

Obsessed.effect: Heal 80 HP to the target and afflict them with CONFIDENCE for 3 turns. If the last use was used up, afflict BRAVERY onto the target.

black licorice.title: Black Licorice
black licorice.effect: Afflict the target with ABHORRENCE for 3 turns. Afterwards, afflict them with EMPOWERED, NIMBLE, and STRATEGIC for 3 turns, also heal them for 40 HP at the start of those turns. If used on Papercraft, these effects last 4 turns instead.
black licorice.description: "Once you get past the bitter notes, the flavor is amazing" -Papercraft

blackout berry.title: Blackout Berry
blackout berry.effect: The target's next action is randomly chosen between FIGHT, all available MAGICs, or DEFEND, however they are afflicted with 1d3+2 Tiers of TRANCED for 3 turns with the effects reversed.
blackout berry.description:
Eat this and you'll fail to remember your next turn! ...Wait why would anyone want this-*
Price: 10 Candy

Well-Liked.effect: The target's next 2 actions are randomly chosen between FIGHT, all available MAGICs, or DEFEND, however they are afflicted with 1d4+3 Tiers of TRANCED for 3 turns with the effects reversed; this bypasses the normal Tier Limit.

Obsessed.effect: The target's next 3 actions are randomly chosen between FIGHT, all available MAGICs, or DEFEND, however they are afflicted with 1d5+4 Tiers of TRANCED for 4 turns with the effects reversed; this bypasses the normal Tier Limit.

blueberry-white chocolate cake.title: Blueberry-White Chocolate Cake
blueberry-white chocolate cake.effect: Heals the party equal to their White Chocolate Rating x10.
blueberry-white chocolate cake.description: Fresh Blueberries baked with creamy White Chocolate into a cake made to share. Recipe made by the partner of the maid who made the Sylna Cookies.

butterscotch-cinnamon pie.title: Butterscotch-Cinnamon Pie
butterscotch-cinnamon pie.effect:
Apply a 30 HP shield on the target. While the shield is still up and active, the target overheals 1d15+10 HP at the start of their turns. Apply effect corresponding to how much HP they heal.
- 11 - 14: Nothing
- 15 - 18: The target is afflicted with COZY for 1 turn. (Duration Stacks if COZY is already afflicted.)
- 19 - 21: The target is afflicted with LIGHT (I) and COZY for 1 turn. (Duration Stacks if COZY is already afflicted.)
- 22 - 24: The target is afflicted with LIGHT (I) and COZY for 2 turns. (Duration Stacks if COZY is already afflicted.)
- 25: The target is afflicted with LIGHT (I) and COZY for 2 turns along with JOYFUL. (Duration Stacks if COZY is already afflicted.)
butterscotch-cinnamon pie.description: Do you prefer Cinnamon or Butterscotch? Well, no matter what you said, you will always get the same result.

Well-Liked.effect:
Apply a shield on the target equal to half their MAX HP. While the shield is still up and active, the target overheals 1d15+10 HP at the start of their turns. Apply effect corresponding to how much HP they heal.
- 11 - 14: Nothing
- 15 - 18: The target is afflicted with COZY for 1 turn. (Duration Stacks if COZY is already afflicted.)
- 19 - 21: The target is afflicted with LIGHT (I) and COZY for 1 turn. (Duration Stacks if COZY is already afflicted.) During their next turn, if they use FIGHT or a Damaging MAGIC, they can reroll any 1 roll when casting.
- 22 - 24: The target is afflicted with  LIGHT (I) and COZY for 2 turns. (Duration Stacks if COZY is already afflicted.) During their next turn, if they use FIGHT or a Damaging MAGIC, they can reroll any 1 roll when casting.
- 25: The target is afflicted with LIGHT (I) and COZY for 2 turns along with JOYFUL. (Duration Stacks if COZY is already afflicted.) During their next turn, if they use FIGHT or a Damaging MAGIC, they can treat the HIT as a Natural 20.

Obsessed.effect:
Apply a shield on the target equal to their MAX HP. While the shield is still up and active, the target overheals 1d15+10 HP at the start of their turns. Apply effect corresponding to how much HP they heal.
- 11 - 14: The target is afflicted with COZY for 1 turn. (Duration Stacks if COZY is already afflicted.)
- 15 - 18: The target is afflicted with COZY for 2 turns. (Duration Stacks if COZY is already afflicted.)
- 19 - 21: The target is afflicted with LIGHT (I) and COZY for 2 turns. (Duration Stacks if COZY is already afflicted.) During their next turn, if they use FIGHT or a Damaging MAGIC, they can reroll any 1 roll when casting.
- 22 - 24: The target is afflicted with LIGHT (I) and COZY for 3 turns. (Duration Stacks if COZY is already afflicted.) During their next turn, if they use FIGHT or a Damaging MAGIC, they can reroll any 1 roll when casting.
- 25: The target is afflicted with LIGHT (I) and COZY for 3 turns along with JOYFUL. (Duration Stacks if COZY is already afflicted.) During their next turn, if they use FIGHT or a Damaging MAGIC, they can treat the HIT as a Natural 20.

candy.title: Candy
candy.effect:
Roll 1d20 and apply the corresponding effects. Retains turn after use.
1 - Can-die: Damage the target for their unmodified MAX HP. If the target has overheal, they lose it before taking damage. If the target survives, they gain an extra turn on their next turn and have +5 HIT until the end of the extra turn. This damage bypasses shields and is not reducible.
2 - Bad Aftertaste: Damage the target for 10 damage at the start and end of their turn for the next 3 turns.
3 - Horrible Aftertaste: Damage the target for 15 damage at the start of their turn for the next 5 turns.
4 - Expired Candy: Deals 50 damage to the target.
5 - Butterfingers: No ITEMs can be used by the target for the next 2 turns. The target’s weapon’s effects become ineffective for the same duration.
6 - Jinkies!: The target is afflicted with BLINDNESS (III) for 2 turns.
7 - Regurgitate: Add the last ITEM the target used excluding this one back into their inventory. If no ITEMs have been used, re-add this ITEM instead.
8 - Rock Candy - The target rolls 1d5 and their turn is skipped on a 1 - 4, but they cannot take any damage. This lasts for 2 turns.
9 - In The Middle: Sets the target’s HP to 1/2 of their MAX HP.
10 - Brittle: The target’s MAX HP is reduced by 10%, but they gain +2 permanent DODGE.
11 - Volatile Starlight: Give the target a shield equal to 75% of the target’s MAX HP that takes 25% of the shield’s MAX HP as damage at the end of every round and afflict them with STARLIGHT (XII) for as long as the shield is up and 3 turns after, then roll 1d3. On a 1, nothing happens. On a 2, get rid of the shield and damage the target for 1d50+20 damage. On a 3, get rid of the shield and damage the target for their MAX HP -1.
12 - Hard Candy: Increase the target’s MAX HP by 20%, but give them -2 permanent DODGE.
13 - Cinnamon: The target gains +1 permanent DODGE.
14 - Good Aftertaste: The target is healed for 20 HP at the start of their turn for 3 turns.
15 - Great Aftertaste: The target is healed for 15 HP at the start and at the end of their turn for 3 turns.
16 - Prize Inside: Roll 1d182 and add the corresponding ITEM to the target’s inventory.
17 - I Can’t Stop: The target gains +15 DODGE for 1 turn.
18 - Delicious Candy: Heal the party for 75% of their MAX HP.
19 - Cough Drop: The target gains a 50 HP shield. Negate residual damage. If another shield is applied, add the amount of HP the shield has to this one.
20 - Guidance: The target’s DODGE rolls for the next 2 turns are guaranteed dodges & counters and deal quadruple damage.

candy corn.title: Candy Corn
candy corn.effect: Heal the target for 5 HP for every use. For every 10 uses used, roll 1d3. On a 1, afflict the target with HOPE (I) for 1 turn. On a 2, afflict the target with JUSTICE for 1 turn. On a 3, afflict the target with BRAVERY for 1 turn. These STATUSes last for the turns specified and cannot be made permanent. If the target is already afflicted with one of these STATUSes permanently, multiply the effects of the status by 1.5x for the duration it would've been afflicted for.
candy corn.description: These are actually pretty good! Overhated honestly.

Well-Liked.effect: The extra 10 uses only apply if in the inventory of someone who has it as Well-Liked. Heal the target for 5 HP for every use. For every 10 uses used, roll 1d3. On a 1, afflict the target with HOPE (I) for 1 turn. On a 2, afflict the target with JUSTICE for 1 turn. On a 3, afflict the target with BRAVERY for 1 turn. These statuses last for the turns specified and cannot be made permanent. If the target is already afflicted with one of these statuses permanently, multiply the effects of the status by 1.5x for the duration it would've been afflicted for.

Obsessed.effect: The extra 20 uses only apply if in the inventory of someone who has it as Obsessed. Heal the target for 5 HP for every use. For every 10 uses used, roll 1d3. On a 1, afflict the target with HOPE (I) for 1 turn. On a 2, afflict the target with JUSTICE for 1 turn. On a 3, afflict the target with BRAVERY for 1 turn. These statuses last for the turns specified and cannot be made permanent. If the target is already afflicted with one of these statuses permanently, multiply the effects of the status by 1.5x for the duration it would've been afflicted for.

cherry bomb.title: Cherry Bomb
cherry bomb.effect: Heal the target for 60 HP. The next time the target is HIT, Damage the attacker for 60 Damage and any other enemies for 30 Damage. This Damage cannot be reduced.

Well-Liked.effect: The extra use only applies if in the inventory of someone who has it as Well-Liked. Heal the target for 60 HP. The next time the target is HIT, Damage the attacker for 60 Damage and any other enemies for 30 Damage. This Damage cannot be reduced.

Obsessed.effect: The extra 2 uses only apply if in the inventory of someone who has it as Well-Liked. Heal the target for 60 HP. The next time the target is HIT, Damage the attacker for 60 Damage and any other enemies for 30 Damage. This Damage cannot be reduced.

chocolate spikes.title: Chocolate Spikes
chocolate spikes.effect: The target heals for their combined Chocolate Ratings and rolls 1dX, X being equal to their combined Chocolate Ratings.They gain Damage Advantage for 3 turns equal to the result.
chocolate spikes.description: Hurts a bit on the way down, but you sure can bring the hurt too!

chocolate sylna cookie.title: Chocolate Sylna Cookie
chocolate sylna cookie.effect: Heals the target equal to their combined Chocolate Ratings x2. Up to 10 of these ITEMs can take up 1 ITEM slot, and any amount of these ITEMs that share the same ITEM slot can be used at once.
chocolate sylna cookie.description: Ever wanted instant cavities? Well I got the treat for you!

chocolate wafer.title: Chocolate Wafer
chocolate wafer.effect: Heals the target equal to their combined Chocolate Ratings x6. Both uses can be used at once, at either the same or multiple targets.
chocolate wafer.description: Still simple, but better to some people.

clay.title: Clay
clay.effect: Heals the target for 3d20 HP, but afflicts them with SICK for 1 turn. Multiple uses can be used at once, if they are, multiply the SICK duration by the number of uses used.
clay.description: This is clay! Perfect for modeli- Why the fuck are you eating it?

Well-Liked.effect: Heals the target for 3d20 HP, but afflicts them with SICK for 1 turn. Multiple uses can be used at once, if they are, multiply the SICK duration by half the number of uses used, rounded down.

Obsessed.effect: Heals the target for 3d20 HP. Multiple uses can be used at once.

clubs sandwich.title: Clubs Sandwich
clubs sandwich.effect:
Coinflip and apply the effect. If this ITEM is used on Phalia, then she can choose the result of the coinflip and can choose the next Suit she wants from "Jack of All Trades". Apply this Suit for 4 turns instead.
- Heads: Heal the targets for 40 HP. Deal X/Y damage to all enemies; X is equal to 1/2 the amount healed across all party members and Y is equal to the amount of enemies. The user gains a random enemy's FIGHT HIT advantage for 2 turns and the corresponding enemy loses it.
- Tails:  Heal the targets for 100 HP. Deal X/Y damage to all enemies; X is equal to 1/2 the amount healed across all party members and Y is equal to the amount of enemies.
clubs sandwich.description:
A sandwich to share with everyone!*
Price: 10 Candy

cranberry.title: Cranberry
cranberry.effect: Afflict the target with CHAOTIC that rolls 1d9+1 for 3 turns. Coinflip afterwards, and if it is heads, the first turn CHAOTIC rolls 1d9+2 instead. When rolling the first d9, heal the afflicted for the result x10. A 10 on CHAOTIC lets the afflicted choose which effect to apply, and 11 lets the afflicted choose 2 effects to apply.
cranberry.description: This one berry is just the Monkey's Paw version of a Miracle Berry. Proceed with caution.

dark candy.title: Dark Candy
dark candy.effect: Heals 40 HP to the target. Next time one of the target’s FIGHT or MAGIC succeeds it afflicts DARK (II) for 3 turns to the target of it. DARK (I) if the move is AoE. Retains turn after use.

dark chocolate bar.effect: Heals HP equal to the target’s White Chocolate Rating x15.

dust bunny.title: Dust Bunny
dust bunny.effect: When the first use is used, this heals 50 HP, gives the target +4 Critical Chance for 1 turn, and another use cannot be used in the same battle. dust bunny.description: You get to keep more as long as you don't eat too much! Also this isn't even food-

eternal hibachi.title: Eternal Hibachi
eternal hibachi.effect: Afflict the target with (SOFT) BURN without a disadvantage for 2 turns. If the target chooses to cast a MAGIC during their next turn, they can choose a non-Ultimate MAGIC that is on Cooldown and cast it, paying 10 HP for each turn it has left on Cooldown. If used on Damion, the disadvantage of (SOFT) BURN becomes an advantage, and he instead heals 10 HP for each turn left if he casts a MAGIC already on Cooldown during his next turn.
eternal hibachi.description: "...S-Sylna made this for me... and... it... might just be the best thing I've eaten... except her cookies..." -Damion

fast food.title: Fast Food
fast food.effect:
Afflict the target with NIMBLE for 2 turns, then roll 1d4.
1. Fries: Heals the target for 30 HP and doesn't use up this ITEM. If this effect already took place, heal for 50 instead and use up this ITEM.
2. Burger: Heal the target for 60 HP and afflict them with JOYFUL.
3. Apple Slices: Heal the target for 20 HP and afflict them with HEALTHY for 4 turns.

fast food.description:
Hilinis City's new Joyful Feast! The nuggets come in the shapes of the warriors that work hard to keep danger at bay. …The Toy is the most nutritious part.*
Price: 10 Candy

Obsessed.effect: Afflict the target with NIMBLE for 2 turns, then roll 1d6.

feisty slider.title: Feisty Slider
feisty slider.effect: Any amount of uses can be used on one target. For every use, heal the target for 35 HP and afflict them with CONFIDENCE for 1 turn; this duration stacks if more than one use was used at a time. If used on Clover, heal him for 55 HP per use and afflict him with INTEGRITY for 3 turns as well if all uses were used.
feisty slider.description: "Ah! Just like how the Wild East made 'em. Only the best can eat this slider in one bite. Brings back good ol' memories." -Clover

fettuccine alfredo.title: Fettuccine Alfredo
fettuccine alfredo.effect: Heals the target for 100 HP. If the target has an ability or move that has something to do with points (Concentration, Battle Tactics, etc.), raise it by 10% of its maximum points (10 if there is no maximum).
fettuccine alfredo.description: So good you could jump off of an impossibly tall hospital building for.

fish sticks.title: Fish Sticks

fish sticks.description: What are you, a gay fish?

fruitcake.title: Fruitcake
fruitcake.effect: Heals the target for 45 HP and afflicts them with a random Good STATUS for 2 turns. If the target FIGHTs and HITs during their next turn, afflict 1 random Bad STATUS onto the target for 2 turns.
fruitcake.description: Yummy and perfect for the holidays! Burns a bit on the way down though...

Well-Liked.effect: Heals the target for 60 HP and afflicts them with a random Good STATUS for 3 turns. If the target FIGHTs and HITs during their next turn, afflict 1 random Bad STATUS onto the target for 3 turns.

Obsessed.effect: Heals the target for 75 HP and afflicts them with a random Good STATUS for 4 turns. If the target FIGHTs and HITs during their next turn, afflict 1 random Bad STATUS onto the target for 4 turns.

fruity parfait.title: Fruity Parfait

garnish.title: Garnish
garnish.effect: The user also chooses 1 Food ITEM to use along with this ITEM. The target overheals 50 HP alongside what they would've healed and is afflicted with 1 random Good STATUS for 3 turns that they aren't already afflicted with. garnish.description: A perfect pinch of greens to top of any food! ...WHY ARE YOU USING THIS ON GLASS-

grape.title: Grape
grape.effect: Heal for 33% of the target’s HP. Afflict the target with BLESSED (VIII) and LUCKY for 2 turns; these can combine into TREASURED.

grapefruit.title: Grapefruit
grapefruit.effect: Heals 75 HP and afflicts the target with LUCKY for 1 turn.

Obsessed.effect: Heals 120 HP. Afflict the target with LUCKY for 3 turns. The target's next 3 coinflips are Guaranteed to be Heads.

grass cake.title: Grass Cake
grass cake.effect: Heals the user’s party for 10 HP and afflicts them all with MOSSY for 2 turns.

Well-Liked.effect: Heals the user’s party for 10 HP and afflicts them all with MOSSY for 2 turns. The user heals 30 HP instead and is afflicted with MOSSY for 3 turns.

gravity granola.title: Gravity Granola
gravity granola.effect: Heals the target for 60 HP and gives them +3 DODGE for 2 turns.
gravity granola.description: Granola, now in a gravity defying form! Screw Issac Newton, what does he know about gravity?

Well-Liked.effect: Heals the target for 70 HP and has +3 DODGE for 3 turns. The next non-Guaranteed attack toward them is a Guaranteed DODGE, as well as any other non-Guaranteed attacks until the start of their next turn.

grilled cheese.title: Grilled Cheese
grilled cheese.effect: Heal 75 HP to the target and afflicts them with CONFIDENCE for 2 turns. Their next FIGHT or Damaging MAGIC deals +15 in Damage.

honey bun.title: Honey Bun

honey bun.description: Better when you try it a second time!

hotel mix.title: Hotel Mix
hotel mix.effect: Any amount of uses can be used at once, on different targets. Heals the target for 40 HP and they roll 1d3. If 1, they heal that same amount of HP at the start of their next turn. ice cream.title: Ice Cream
ice cream.effect: Roll 1d4 on use. If 2-4, heal the target for 70 HP and another 70 HP at the start of their next turn, and also afflict them with JOYFUL. If 1, afflict the target with FURIOUS and SAD for 3 turns, without SAD's DODGE disadvantage, instead.
