moss.title: Moss
moss.effect: Heals the target for 30 HP and afflicts them with MOSSY for 3 turns.

Well-Liked.effect: Heals the target for 30 HP and afflicts them with MOSSY for 3 turns. While a character has this as Well-Liked, any MOSSY instead does 1d40 Overheal at the start of their turn.

Obsessed.effect: Heals the target for 30 HP and afflicts them with MOSSY for 3 turns. While a character has this as Well-Liked, any MOSSY instead does Double 1d30 Overheal at the start of their turn.

moss ball.title: Moss Ball
moss ball.effect: Afflict the target with FIT and MOSSY for 3 turns. This MOSSY applies the Obsessed effect for Moss. If used on Leafen, use the Obsessed effect for Moss for the rest of that battle instead.
moss ball.description: Finally, the garden has been put to good use. -Leafen

nanner.title: Nanner
nanner.effect: Heals the target for 75 HP and places a “Nanner Peel” ITEM to their inventory.
nanner.description:
I swear this is different from the Banana ITEM.*
Price: 15 Candy

Well-Liked.effect: Heals the target for 80 HP and places a “Nanner Peel” ITEM to their inventory; the given “Nanner Peel” can target two different Party Members for its effect, but only triggers once.

Obsessed.effect: Heals the target for 90 HP and places a “Nanner Peel” ITEM to their inventory; the given “Nanner Peel” doesn't target a Party Member and instead activates the next time anyone in the Party is attacked.

orange.title: Orange
orange.effect: Heals the target for 10 HP and gives them one charge of the "Instant Increase" effect. Whenever HIT, Damage, or DODGE is rolled, any number of charges of "Instant Increase" can be used to increase the result by 1d2 (or 1d10, if Damage). Retains turn after use.
orange.description: Get your daily dose of Vitamin C! Delicious, and keeps you healed for any fights ahead.

Well-Liked.effect: Heals the target for 10% HP and gives them one charge of the "Instant Increase" effect. If the heal would be less than 10 HP, heal 10 HP instead. Whenever HIT, Damage, or DODGE is rolled, any number of charges of "Instant Increase" can be used to increase the result by 1d2 (or 1d10+5, if Damage). Retains turn after use.

Obsessed.effect:
One or two uses can be used at once. Apply effects corresponding to how many uses were used. Retains turn after use.
* 1 Use: Heal the target for 25% of their MAX HP and gives them one charge of the "Instant Increase" effect. Whenever HIT, Damage, or DODGE is rolled, any number of charges of "Instance Increase" can be used to increase the result by 1d3 (or 1d15+5, if Damage).
* 2 Uses: Heal the target for 50% of their MAX HP and gives them two charges of the "Instance Increase" effect. Whenever HIT, Damage, or DODGE is rolled, any number of charges of "Instant Increase" can be used to increase the result by 1d3 (or 1d15+5, if Damage).

peanut-butter wafer.title: Peanut-Butter Wafer
peanut-butter wafer.effect: Heals the target for 60 HP, and another 60 HP at the start of their next turn. Both uses can be used at once, at either the same or multiple targets.
peanut-butter wafer.description: So good, you can eat it a second time!

Well-Liked.effect: Heals the target for 75 HP, and another 75 HP at the start of their next turn. Both uses can be used at once, at either the same or multiple targets.

Obsessed.effect: Heals the target for 90 HP, and another 90 HP at the start of their next turn. Both uses can be used at once, at either the same or multiple targets.

pizza.title: Pizza
pizza.effect: Heals 60 HP. Multiple uses can be used at once, but only 1 per party member.
pizza.description: A steaming hot Pizza from your favorite bakery! With the stamp of approval from a familiar green dinosaur, it is guaranteed to make your mouth water.

Well-Liked.effect: Heals 60 HP. Multiple uses can be used at once, but only 1 per party member; the user can use up to 2 uses on themselves. Afflict the user with CONFIDENCE for 2 turns after use.

Obsessed.effect: Heals 60 HP, and 75 HP to the user. Multiple uses can be used at once, but only 1 per party member; the user can use as many uses on themselves as they want. Afflict the user with CONFIDENCE for 4 turns after use.

poisoned cake.title: Poisoned Cake
poisoned cake.effect: Heals the target for their MAX HP and reduces all of their CDs to 0 except for Ultimate MAGICs, but afflicts PARALYZED onto the target for 3 turns.
poisoned cake.description: This cake looks... off... but looks SO good!... maybe just a little bite?

poppo cake.title: Poppo Cake
poppo cake.effect: Heals the party for 40 HP. The user rolls 1d5 afterward; Damage all enemies for X*10 HP and heal the party for an extra X*5 HP, X being the result of the roll.
poppo cake.description: The answer to what exactly a Poppo is has not been answered yet… But whatever they are, they took after Sylna’s cooking and made this cake!

Well-Liked.effect: Heals the party for 40 HP. The user rolls 2d5 afterward; Damage all enemies for X*10 HP and heal the party for an extra X*5 HP, X being the result of the rolls.

Obsessed.effect: Heals the party for 40 HP. The user rolls 3d5 afterward; Damage all enemies for X*10 HP and heal the party for an extra X*5 HP, X being the result of the rolls. The user also chooses an enemy; that enemy has +1 in every advantage instead of their usual advantages until the end of the user’s next turn.

pumpkin chocolate.title: Pumpkin Chocolate
pumpkin chocolate.effect:
Heal the target for their combined chocolate ratings x2. Apply the effects corresponding to their chocolate rating.
15+: The target heals the same amount of HP at the start of their next turn.
20+: This heals for 4x the combined chocolate rating of the targets instead.
25+: Afflict the target with STRATEGIC for 2 turns.
30+: Afflict the target with EMPOWERED for 2 turns.
31+: Afflict the target with REFRESHED.
pumpkin chocolate.description: KEEP AWAY FROM THE CHOCOLATE GIRL. I REPEAT. KEEP AWAY FROM THE CHOCOLATE GI-

pure cacao.title: Pure Cacao
pure cacao.effect: Overheals the target equal to their Combined Chocolate Ratings x3. If used on Chara, she gains +1d2 to her next Bars Rolls for FIGHT.
pure cacao.description: "I will cut off your hand if you even THINK about taking this away.” -Chara

rabbit stew.title: Rabbit Stew
rabbit stew.effect: Heal the target for 120 HP. If the target’s next Action requires them to Concentrate, they can choose to skip a turn of Concentration; if they are already Concentrating, they can either cast it immediately or Concentrate for another turn (if available). If used on Lush, his next 2 "Trap" MAGICs skip 1 turn of concentration.
rabbit stew.description: "Ah, Rabbit Stew, a hunter's delight. You take fresh ingredients from your garden, trap some rabbits, and cook slowly and steadily... Truly a marvelous work." -Lush

rainbow lollipop.title: Rainbow Lollipop
rainbow lollipop.effect: Afflicts the target with 1 STATUS of their choice for 2 turns, also they gain +1 to HIT and DODGE for the same duration.
rainbow lollipop.description: A Lollipop more colorful than an actual rainbow!

Well-Liked.effect: Afflicts the target with 1 STATUS of their choice for 3 turns, also they gain +1 to HIT and DODGE for the same duration.

Obsessed.effect: Afflicts the target with 1 STATUS of their choice for 4 turns, also they gain +2 to HIT and DODGE for the same duration.

rock candy.title: Rock Candy
rock candy.effect: Heals the target to MAX HP, but afflicts them with PETRIFIED; while PETRIFIED, they take no Damage, also they are not afflicted with BRITTLE when cured.
rock candy.description: Rock Candy! Not only heals you, but also makes you Rock Hard. No seriously, it turns you to stone.

Well-Liked.effect: Heals the target to MAX HP, but afflicts them with PETRIFIED; while PETRIFIED, they take no Damage, also they are not afflicted with BRITTLE when cured. This PETRIFIED starts with +2 to the 1d4 roll.

Obsessed.effect: Heals the target to MAX HP and afflicts them with JOYFUL, but also afflicts them with PETRIFIED; while PETRIFIED, they take no Damage, also they are not afflicted with BRITTLE when cured. This PETRIFIED starts with +2 to the 1d4 roll.

rocky road.title: Rocky Road
rocky road.effect: The target heals 50 HP. Twice since use, the target can reroll/reflip any roll/coin.
rocky road.description:
Who the fuck eats a whole road?*
Unlock: ENDLRG

Well-Liked.effect: The target heals 60 HP. Twice since use, the target can reroll/reflip any roll/coin. If the rerolls/reflips were for HIT or DODGE, add +4 to the result. If the rerolls/reflips were for Damage, add +10 to the result.

Obsessed.effect: The target heals 70 HP. Twice since use, the target can reroll/reflip any roll/coin. If the rerolls/reflips were for HIT, Damage, or DODGE, add +6 to the result. If the rerolls/reflips were for Damage, add 1d15+10 to the result. If they weren’t for HIT, Damage, or DODGE, it is rerolled/reflipped 2 more times and the user can choose which roll to apply.

royal macarons.title: Royal Macarons
royal macarons.effect:
Can be used as AoE or not.
- AoE: Heals the caster’s Party for 40 HP and gives +10 to Damage for 2 turns. If one of the Party Members is Plumeria, heal her for 60 HP and give her +15 to Damage for 3 turns instead.
- Not AoE: Heal the target for 60 HP and give +15 to Damage for 3 turns. If the target is Plumeria, heal her for 75 HP and give her +20 to Damage for 3 turns instead.
royal macarons.description: “A bit sweet… kinda embarrassing that my face is here also... but... it's cool I suppose!" - Plumeria

salt-baked salmon.title: Salt-Baked Salmon
salt-baked salmon.effect: Heals the Target for 80 HP, and coinflip. If Heads, afflict ALERT onto the target for 2 turns. If Tails, afflict COZY onto the target for 3 turns.
salt-baked salmon.description: ...Salmon can run? Sure doesn't look like it, but I guess this one had some beef if it's THIS salty.

Well-Liked.effect: Heals the target for 120 HP, and roll 1d3. On a 1, afflict ALERT onto the target for 3 turns. On a 2, afflict COZY onto the target for 4 turns. On a 3, afflict ALERT onto the target for 3 turns and COZY onto the target for 4 turns.

Obsessed.effect: Heals the target for 140 HP, and roll 1d3. On a 1, afflict ALERT onto the target for 3 turns. On a 2, afflict COZY onto the target for 5 turns. On a 3, afflict ALERT onto the target for 3 turns and COZY onto the target for 5 turns. Any heal past MAX HP from Cozy is halved and healed as Overheal.

sandwich.title: Sandwich
sandwich.effect:
Heals 20 HP. The target rolls 1d4 two times and applies the following effects. If both of the dice repeat, do not apply the 20 base healing.
1 - Bacon: Heal 2d20 HP, gain +2 HIT for 3 turns.
2 - Cheese: Heal 3d20 HP, gain  +2 DODGE for 3 turns.
3 - Beef: Heal 4d20 HP, gain +10 Damage for 3 turns.
4 - Lettuce: Heal 1d20 HP, afflict LUCKY for 2 turns.
sandwich.description: Who eats a bacon and cheese sandwich...?

Well-Liked.effect:
Heals 20 HP. The target rolls 1d5 three times and applies the following effects. If two or more of the dice repeat, do not apply the 20 base healing.
1 - Bacon: Heal 2d20 HP, gain +2 HIT for 3 turns.
2 - Cheese: Heal 3d20 HP, gain  +2 DODGE for 3 turns.
3 - Beef: Heal 4d20 HP, gain +10 Damage for 3 turns.
4 - Lettuce: Heal 1d20 HP, afflict LUCKY for 2 turns.
5 - Tomato: Heal 5d20, afflict 1d10 tiers of BLESSED for 2 turns.

Obsessed.effect:
Heals 20 HP. The target rolls 1d6 four times and applies the following effects. If two or more of the dice repeat, do not apply the 20 base healing.
1 - Bacon: Heal 2d20 HP, gain +2 HIT for 3 turns.
2 - Cheese: Heal 3d20 HP, gain  +2 DODGE for 3 turns.
3 - Beef: Heal 4d20 HP, gain +10 Damage for 3 turns.
4 - Lettuce: Heal 1d20 HP, afflict LUCKY for 2 turns.
5 - Tomato: Heal 5d20, afflict 1d10 tiers of BLESSED for 2 turns.
6 - Ghost Pepper: Afflict FURIOUS for 2 turns.

seasonal sensation.title: Seasonal Sensation
seasonal sensation.effect: Roll 1d4. If 1, heal the party for 50 HP and afflict them with (SOFT) BURN for 3 turns. If 2, heal the party for 80 HP. If 3, heal the party for 40 HP and afflict them with FOCUSED for 2 turns. If 4, heal the party for 40 HP and afflict them with MOSSY for 3 turns. If Mini is going to be healed by this ITEM, the d4 roll can either be chosen or rolled twice.
seasonal sensation.description: “I can’t decide if this is hot, cold, or somewhere in the middle… even my body can’t. I’m flickering between 4 different colors here…” - Mini

sour coffins.title: Sour Coffins
sour coffins.effect: Set the target's HP to -30 HP. They cannot be healed from any other means other than natural heal. After their HP is positive, heal them for 0.75x of their MAX HP, and afflict them with CONFIDENCE and COZY for 3 turns and JOYFUL. If the target is the only non-KO'd member in the party, the target is healed for 10 HP.
sour coffins.description: This is so sour that this will literally put you in a coffin!

Well-Liked.effect: Set the target's HP to -40 HP. They cannot be healed from any other means other than natural heal. After their HP is positive, heal them for their MAX HP, and afflict them with CONFIDENCE and COZY for 3 turns, as well as JOYFUL and RELAXED (I). If the target is the only non-KO'd member in the party, the target is healed for 50 HP.

Obsessed.effect: Set the target's HP to -50 HP. They cannot be healed from any other means other than natural heal. After their HP is positive, overheal them for 1.25x of their MAX HP, and afflict them with CONFIDENCE and COZY for 3 turns, as well as JOYFUL and RELAXED (II). If the target is the only non-KO'd member in the party, the target is healed for 100 HP.

sour gummies.title: Sour Gummies
sour gummies.effect: Heals 20 HP and afflicts the target with JOYFUL. Retains turn after use.
sour gummies.description: Just like normal gummies, but with a tangy twi- OH GOD THE PINK YOSHI IS BACK, RUN-!

Well-Liked.effect: Heal 55 HP to the target and afflict the target with JOYFUL. Retains turn after use.

Obsessed.effect: Heal 75% of the target's MAX HP to the target and afflict the target with JOYFUL and REFRESHED for 3 turns. Retains turn after use.

spinach.title: Spinach
spinach.effect: Heals 10 HP. If the target has less than 1/4 of their HP remaining and is not KO’d, they instead recover MAX HP, gain a +20 to Damage for 3 turns, and are afflicted with LUCKY and HEALTHY for the same duration.
spinach.description: If you eats ya spinach, you'll fight to the finish!

Well-Liked.effect: Heals 10 HP. If the target has less than 1/3 of their HP remaining and is not KO’d, they instead recover MAX HP, gain a +20 to Damage for 3 turns, and are afflicted with LUCKY and HEALTHY for the same duration.

Obsessed.effect: Heals 10 HP. If the target has less than 1/2 of their HP remaining and is not KO’d, they instead recover MAX HP, gain a +20 to Damage for 4 turns, and are afflicted with LUCKY and HEALTHY for the same duration.

spiral pie.title: Spiral Pie
spiral pie.effect:
Afflict the target with CORRUPTED for X turns. X being a chosen number by the target (Max: 4). Depending on how many turns it has been since CORRUPTED was afflicted, apply the following effects; Y is equal to the total of the combined digits of the target's HP.
* Turn 1: Y*2 Damage. The afflicted also deals 4/5 damage.
* Turn 2: Y*3 Damage. The afflicted also deals 3/4 damage.
* Turn 3: Y*5 Damage. The afflicted also deals 3/5 damage.
* Turn 4: Y*7 Damage. The afflicted also deals 1/2 Damage.
When CORRUPTED is cured, afflict the target with reversed and doubled CORRUPTED for the amount of turns CORRUPTED was afflicted for. If 4 turns, then only afflict it for 3 turns, but triple the instead of doubling them. Also, increase the target's MAX HP by the turns CORRUPTED was afflicted for x5. (This cannot stack.)
spiral pie.description:
This pie does not seem safe to eat... it’s covered in a red glow with a spiral emblem on the bottom of the pie tin.*
Price: 5 Candy

starlight sundae.title: Starlight Sundae
starlight sundae.effect: Afflicts the whole party with Doubled COZY for 3 turns, and if it would be cured by it's own effect, it is not. If used on Sylna, she is afflicted with RAGE, or 2 more Tiers of it if afflicted already. This bypasses the maximum Tiers of RAGE, but only by up to 2.
starlight sundae.description: "A beautiful sundae with a strawberry syrup and big brownie and ice cream layers. Perfect for a deity!" -Sylna

steak.title: Steak
steak.effect: Heals the target for 60 HP and gives them +1 Critical Chance for the rest of the battle. If this heals the target to MAX HP, they also gain +1 HIT and Devastating Chance. The permanent effects of this ITEM can only stack up to 3 times.
steak.description: Huge steak in the shape of a random huge celebrity's face. Is it made out of real meat...?

Well-Liked.effect: Heals the target for 80 HP and gives them +1 Critical and Devastating Chance for the rest of the battle. If this heals the target to MAX HP, they also gain +1 HIT and +1 Celestial Chance; if they cannot already gain a Celestial multiplier from HIT, they instead deal Celestial (4x) Damage on a HIT of 30+. The permanent effects of this ITEM can only stack up to 3 times.

Obsessed.effect: Heals the target for 100 HP and gives them +2 Critical and +1 Devastating Chance for the rest of the battle. If this ITEM heals the target to MAX HP, they also gain +1 HIT and +1 Celestial Chance; if they cannot already gain a Celestial multiplier from HIT, they instead deal Celestial (4x) Damage on a HIT of 28+. The permanent effects of this ITEM can only stack up to 3 times.

strawberry cheesecake.title: Strawberry Cheesecake
strawberry cheesecake.effect: Heals the party for 25 HP, afflicts them with 4d5 Tiers of BLESSED for 1 turn, and retains turn after use.

Well-Liked.effect: Heals the party for 25 HP, afflicts them with 4d5 Tiers of BLESSED for 1 turn, and retains turn after use. The user heals 45 HP instead.

Obsessed.effect: Heals the party for 25 HP, afflicts them with 4d5 Tiers of BLESSED for 1 turn, and retains turn after use. The user heals 45 HP instead, and is also afflicted with FOCUSED for 2 turns and JOYFUL.

strawberry-dark chocolate cake.title: Strawberry-Dark Chocolate Cake
strawberry-dark chocolate cake.effect: Heals the party equal to their Dark Chocolate Ratings x10.
strawberry-dark chocolate cake.description: Fresh Strawberries baked with savory Dark Chocolate into a cake made to share. Recipe made by the partner of the maid who made the Sylna Cookies.

strawberry sylna cookie.title: Strawberry Sylna Cookie
strawberry sylna cookie.effect: Heals the target for 20 HP and afflicts them with a random Good SOUL STATUS for 2 turns (this does not stack). Up to 10 of these ITEMs can take up 1 ITEM slot, and any amount of these ITEMs that share the same ITEM slot can be used at once.

Well-Liked.effect: Heals the target for 25 HP and afflicts them with a random Good SOUL STATUS for 4 turns (this does not stack). Up to 10 of these ITEMs can take up 1 ITEM slot, and any amount of these ITEMs that share the same ITEM slot can be used at once. For every 3 uses past 1, increase the duration of the STATUS by 1 turn.

Obsessed.effect: Heals the target for 25 HP and coinflip; if heads, afflict the target with their primary SOUL STATUS (this does not stack). If tails, afflict the target with their secondary SOUL STATUS. If the target already has both, or they don’t have a primary/secondary SOUL STATUS, afflict them with a random Good STATUS for 1 turn. Up to 10 of these ITEMs can take up 1 ITEM slot, and any amount of these ITEMs that share the same ITEM slot can be used at once. For every 3 uses past 1, double the effects of the STATUS for 1 turn.

strawberry wafer.title: Strawberry Wafer
strawberry wafer.effect: Heals 65 HP. Both uses can be used at once, at either the same or multiple targets. The target chooses 5 SOUL STATUSes and is afflicted with a random one chosen for 2 turns.
strawberry wafer.description: Finally, one to complete the Basic Trinity.

Well-Liked.effect: Heals 85 HP. Both uses can be used at once, at either the same or multiple targets. The target chooses 5 SOUL STATUSes and is afflicted with a random one chosen for 3 turns.

Obsessed.effect: Heals 110 HP. Both uses can be used at once, at either the same or multiple targets. The target chooses 5 SOUL STATUSes and is afflicted with a random one chosen for 4 turns.

straw-hazel tiramisu.title: Straw-Hazel Tiramisu
straw-hazel tiramisu.effect: Heals the party for 40 HP, then each healed member rolls 1d4. If 1, afflict them with LIGHT (I). If 2, afflict them with JOYFUL. If 3, afflict them with STRONG for 2 turns. If 4, afflict them with FOCUSED for 2 turns. If Ashlette is healed this way, she can choose to immediately cast Deck of Many Things, ignoring its Cooldown.
straw-hazel tiramisu.description: "A perfect mix of strawberry and hazelnut to bring this creamy dessert to life. 100% free of any DEMON CANDY!" -Ashlette

sub sandwich.title: Sub Sandwich
sub sandwich.effect:
Heals 20 HP to the party. Each Party Member rolls 1d4 two times and applies the following effects to themselves. If both of the dice repeat, do not apply the 20 base healing.
1 - Meatball: Heal 4d20 HP, gain +10 Damage for 2 turns.
2 - Cheese: Heal 3d20 HP, gain +2 DODGE for 2 turns.
3 - Lettuce: Heal 1d20 HP, afflict LUCKY for 2 turns.
4 - Tomato: Heal 2d20 HP, afflict STRONG for 2 turns.
sub sandwich.description: "I like meatball subs, I mean WHO DOESN'T?!" - Chaos

Well-Liked.effect:
Heals 20 HP to the party. Each Party Member rolls 1d5 three times and applies the following effects to themselves. If 2 or more of the dice repeat, do not apply the 20 base healing.
1 - Meatball: Heal 4d20 HP, +10 Damage Advantage for 2 turns.
2 - Cheese: Heal 3d20 HP, +2 DODGE Advantage for 2 turns.
3 - Lettuce: Heal 1d20 HP, afflict LUCKY for 2 turns.
4 - Tomato: Heal 2d20 HP, afflict STRONG for 2 turns.
5 - Bacon: Heal 5d20 HP, +2 HIT Advantage for 2 turns.

Obsessed.effect:
Heals 20 HP to the party. Each Party Member rolls 1d6 four times and applies the following effects to themselves. If more than 2 of the dice repeat, do not apply the 20 base healing.
1 - Meatball: Heal 2d20 HP, +10 Damage Advantage for 2 turns.
2 - Cheese: Heal 3d20 HP, +2 DODGE Advantage for 2 turns.
3 - Lettuce: Heal 1d20 HP, afflict LUCKY for 2 turns.
4 - Tomato: Heal 2d20 HP, afflict STRONG for 2 turns.
5 - Bacon: Heal 5d20 HP, +2 HIT Advantage for 2 turns.
6 - Nails: Next FIGHT or Damaging MAGIC afflicts BLEED (X) to the target(s).

sunflower seeds.title: Sunflower Seeds
sunflower seeds.effect: Heals the target(s) for 7 HP. As many uses can be used on as many targets as once.

Well-Liked.effect: Heals the target(s) for 7 HP. As many uses can be used on as many targets as once. The user heals 12 HP per use instead.

Obsessed.effect: Heals the target(s) for 10 HP. As many uses can be used on as many targets as once. The user heals 12 HP per use instead and is afflicted with STARLIGHT (I) for 5 turns per use; this STARLIGHT bypasses normal Tier Limits.

super-choco cake.title: Super-Choco Cake
super-choco cake.effect: Heals the party equal to their Combined Chocolate Ratings x5.

supersour suckers.title: SuperSour Suckers
supersour suckers.effect: Afflict the target with STIFF for 2 turns. After that duration is up, afflict them with ALERT, CONFIDENCE, and LUCKY for the same duration. If used on Cassi, the duration is 3 turns instead, also it afflicts STARLIGHT (V) for the duration.
supersour suckers.description: "...Wait, this is sour to you guys? What do you mean? This is nothing." -Cassi

sylna cake.title: Sylna Cake
sylna cake.effect: Heals the party for 15 HP. Multiple uses can be used at once.
sylna cake.description: Like the Sylna Cookies? Well don't you worry, the master baker has another product: *The Sylna Cake. Enjoy a slice with friends or eat it all yourself! No one will judge~

Well-Liked.effect: Heals the party for 20 HP. Multiple uses can be used at once.

Obsessed.effect: Heals the party for 25 HP. Multiple uses can be used at once. Afflicts the party with 1 random Good STATUS for 2 turns (this does not stack). For every 2 uses past 1, afflict the STATUS for 1 more turn.

sylna cookie.title: Sylna Cookie
sylna cookie.effect: Heals 20 HP. Up to 10 of these ITEMs can take up 1 ITEM slot, and any amount of these ITEMs that share the same ITEM slot can be used at once.
sylna cookie.description: A delicious cookie baked with Chocolate, Butterscotch, and Cinnamon. The recipe was said to be made by a bored maid who wanted to treat her friends.

Well-Liked.effect: Heals 25 HP. Up to 10 of these ITEMs can take up 1 ITEM slot, and any amount of these ITEMs that share the same ITEM slot can be used at once.

Obsessed.effect: Heals 30 HP. Afflict the target with a random Good STATUS for 2 turns (this does not stack); for every 2 uses past 1, increase the duration of the STATUS by 1 turn.

trash.title: Trash
trash.effect: Heals 10 HP and gives the target +5 DODGE for 3 turns. The target also rolls 1d4; if a 1, afflict them with SICK permanently.
trash.description: Ew… This is not food, do not eat this. Hey! Stop trying to eat yourself! You are not food!

Well-Liked.effect: Heals 20 HP and gives the target +5 DODGE for 3 turns. Afflict the target with a random Neutral STATUS for the same duration.

Obsessed.effect: Heals 20 HP and gives the target +5 DODGE for 3 turns. Afflict the target with a random Neutral STATUS for the same duration, with the negative effects negated.

vanilla wafer.title: Vanilla Wafer
vanilla wafer.effect: Heals 90 HP. Both uses can be used at once, at either the same or multiple targets.
vanilla wafer.description: ...Yeah. It's a simple Vanilla Wafer, the fuck you expect?

Well-Liked.effect: Heals 120 HP. Both uses can be used at once, at either the same or multiple targets.

Obsessed.effect: Heals 160 HP. Both uses can be used at once, at either the same or multiple targets.

watermelon.title: Watermelon
watermelon.effect:
Heal the target for 40 HP. The next time the target HITs a FIGHT/MAGIC, afflict the target of it with WEAKENED (III) for 5 turns. This WEAKENED can go to Tier (I) to (X). If WEAKENED is already afflicted or is afflicted when Tiered WEAKENED is, add 2 Tiers to affliction. If WEAKENED is doubled, add 5 tiers to affliction. For each tier of WEAKENED, apply the effects onto the afflicted:
- -2 Damage dealt per tier.
- -1 HIT per 2 tiers.
- +4 damage taken per tier.
watermelon.description: Your favorite melons but infused with water from the fountain of yout- hey! This is just a regular watermelon!!! Perfect for when you’re swimming.

Well-Liked.effect:
Heal the target for 70 HP. The next time the target HITs a FIGHT/MAGIC, afflict the target of it with WEAKENED (V) for 5 turns. This WEAKENED can go to Tier (I) to (X). If WEAKENED is already afflicted or is afflicted when tiered WEAKENED is, add 2 tiers to affliction. If WEAKENED is doubled, add 5 tiers to affliction. For each tier of WEAKENED, apply the effects onto the afflicted:
- -2 Damage dealt per tier.
- -1 HIT per 2 tiers.
- +5 damage taken per tier.

Obsessed.effect:
Heal the target for 100 HP. The next time the target HITs a FIGHT/MAGIC, afflict the target of it with WEAKENED (VI) for 5 turns. This WEAKENED can go to Tier (I) to (XV). If WEAKENED is already afflicted or is afflicted when tiered WEAKENED is, add 2 tiers to affliction. If WEAKENED is doubled, add 5 tiers to affliction.
